name: io.github.Onplana/mcp-server
title: Onplana
description: Project portfolio management for PMOs and operations teams — projects, tasks, sprints, risks, comments, and wiki, with hybrid BM25 + vector search across an organization's indexed content. Built as a Microsoft Project Online alternative ahead of its September 2026 retirement. OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) or Personal Access Token auth, server-side plan and role gating, audited end to end, soft-deletes only.

headers.description: OAuth 2.1 access token (DCR supported at https://app.onplana.com/oauth/register, RFC 7591) or a Personal Access Token from https://app.onplana.com/integrations
